purpose: Owner recordings for wake heads. The deployed heads were trained only on designed synthetic voices, so the owner's own voice is out of distribution: hex does not trigger, elissa/pi/otacon are hit or miss. Positives teach the owner's voice; confusables are hard negatives. Saving is not training consent; review first.

protocol.capture: one Record press runs every take for the selected word and session: 0.8 s cue, 2.6 s window, 0.4 s break.
protocol.save: private on this host as an owner-wake-candidate with word, form, language, style, session and taken number; unreviewed, trainingEligible false
protocol.coverage: the page shows how many accepted takes exist per word and session so gaps are visible
